question.worked_solution:
First, we apply the constant factor rule and take the coefficient $-3$ out of the integral. Then we compute the integral of $\frac{1}{x},$ and get

$$
\begin{aligned}\int -\frac{3}{x}\,\text{d}x & =-3\int \frac{1}{x}\,\text{d}x \\  & =-3ln⁡|x|+C.\end{aligned}
$$
